paragraphs.gd: Is mise Mairi. Tha mi a' fuireach ann an Glaschu. Anns a' mhadainn, tha mi ag ithe briosgaidean agus ag òl tì.
paragraphs.en: I am Mairi. I live in Glasgow. In the morning, I eat biscuits and drink tea.

paragraphs.gd: An-dèidh sin, tha mi a' falbh dhan sgoil. Tha mo charaid, Iain, a' fuireach faisg air an sgoil.
paragraphs.en: After that, I go to school. My friend, Iain, lives near the school.

paragraphs.gd: Feasgar, tha sinn a' coimhead film còmhla. Tha e gu math toilichte.
paragraphs.en: In the evening, we watch a film together. He is very happy.

paragraphs.gd: Tha taigh beag agam. Tha e dearg agus geal. Anns an taigh, tha cù dubh agus cat buidhe.
paragraphs.en: I have a small house. It is red and white. In the house, there is a black dog and a yellow cat.

paragraphs.gd: Tha mo theaghlach a' fuireach còmhla rium: mo mhàthair, m' athair, agus mo phiuthar.
paragraphs.en: My family lives with me: my mother, my father, and my sister.

paragraphs.gd: An-uiridh, chaidh mi air turas gun Eilean Sgitheanach le mo theaghlach. Ghabh sinn an trèana gu Inbhir Nis, agus an uair sin am bus.
paragraphs.en: Last year, I went on a trip to the Isle of Skye with my family. We took the train to Inverness, and then the bus.

paragraphs.gd: Bha an t-sìde fuar ach grianach. Choisich sinn anns na beanntan agus thog sinn mòran dhealbhan.
paragraphs.en: The weather was cold but sunny. We walked in the mountains and took many photos.

paragraphs.gd: Is toil leam a bhith a' siubhal, gu h-àraidh nuair a tha an t-sìde math. B' e turas air leth a bh' ann.
paragraphs.en: I like traveling, especially when the weather is good. It was a wonderful trip.

paragraphs.gd: Tha mi ag obair ann an oifis mhòr ann an Dùn Èideann. Ged a tha an obair inntinneach, tha i uaireannan duilich leis cho trang 's a tha i.
paragraphs.en: I work in a big office in Edinburgh. Although the work is interesting, it is sometimes difficult because of how busy it is.

paragraphs.gd: Nam biodh barrachd ùine agam, dh'ionnsaichinn barrachd Gàidhlig agus bhithinn a' leughadh tuilleadh leabhraichean.
paragraphs.en: If I had more time, I would learn more Gaelic and I would read more books.

paragraphs.gd: Thuirt mo cho-obraiche gun robh i airson atharrachadh a dhèanamh air a cosnadh am bliadhna, oir bha i a' faireachdainn gun robh dùbhlain ùra a dhìth oirre.
paragraphs.en: My colleague said that she wanted to make a change to her job this year, because she felt that she needed new challenges.

paragraphs.gd: Thathar ag ràdh gu bheil an riaghaltas gu bhith a' foillseachadh poileasaidh ùr a thaobh na h-àrainneachd an ath-mhìos. A rèir choltais, bidh seo a' toirt buaidh mhòr air gnìomhachasan air feadh na dùthcha.
paragraphs.en: It is being said that the government is going to publish a new environmental policy next month. Apparently, this will have a major effect on businesses across the country.

paragraphs.gd: Air an làimh eile, tha cuid a' cumail a-mach gu bheil am buileachadh ro mhall, agus gu bheil feum air gnìomh nas luaithe a thaobh atharrachadh na gnàth-shìde.
paragraphs.en: On the other hand, some maintain that the implementation is too slow, and that faster action is needed regarding climate change.

paragraphs.gd: Aig a' cheann thall, 's dòcha gur e fianais eacanomach agus sòisealta còmhla a bheir buaidh air a' cho-dhùnadh mu dheireadh, seach argamaidean poilitigeach a-mhàin.
paragraphs.en: Ultimately, it may be economic and social evidence together that influences the final decision, rather than political arguments alone.
